seed_use.draw_seed: section 3: the one seeded order of the units that pass the BIC gates (ids sorted, then a Fisher-Yates shuffle with seededRandom(draw_seed))
seed_use.order_seed: section 6: each unit's session order within its part (stream order_seed + 0 for the pilot, + 1 for the counted run)
seed_use.bootstrap_seed: section 10: every bootstrap over repositories (10,000 resamples)

mint_command: crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint32Array(3)) in one program, read once as draw_seed, order_seed and bootstrap_seed
mint_rule: Minted once from crypto random bytes as unsigned 32-bit integers before any draw, label or session. Never re-minted.

draw.pending_rule: a gate with no record stops the walk where it stands

bic.rebase: the BIC's text diff with no context lines, stripped paths left out, reverse-applied at the fix base with git apply -R --unidiff-zero --reject; rejected hunks are left out and listed

look.at: half the counted units, rounded up, in plan order, once each has all its planned G+ and G0 sessions on both models; an unfinished unit is waited for, never replaced
